scientific limitations/integrity: The classification is for standard Hopf immersions whose profile is a multiply traversed great circle. It does not assert existence of simple initial Willmore-flow data converging to every multiplicity m>=3. The lattice, energy, and mass formulas are derived from the primary source's exact Hopf--elastic dictionary and density theorem; the modular collision classification is proved from the standard PSL(2,Z) fundamental domain. The packaged checker only replays exact algebraic identities and does not substitute finite enumeration for the modular proof.
title: Modular multiplicity classification for Clifford Hopf covers
